<p class="page-intro">My research covers development, environmental, and AI economics, with a focus on energy systems, climate adaptation, structural transformation, and new technologies in low- and middle-income countries.</p>

::: {.research-filter-note}
<span>Fields</span>
<strong>Development economics</strong>
<strong>Environmental &amp; energy economics</strong>
<strong>AI &amp; technology</strong>
:::

## Working papers

<div class="paper-list">
<div class="paper-row">
<div class="paper-row-main">
<p class="paper-meta">Theory · AI and development</p>
<h3><a href="papers/ai-ladder-of-development.html">AI and the Ladder of Development</a></h3>
<p class="paper-authors">Tim Dobermann</p>
<p>Develops a small open-economy model in which frontier AI can raise current productivity yet slow capability accumulation by reallocating labour toward weak-learning local services.</p>
</div>
<div class="paper-row-side">
<span class="paper-status">Working paper</span>
</div>
</div>

<div class="paper-row">
<div class="paper-row-main">
<p class="paper-meta">Climate adaptation · India</p>
<h3><a href="papers/human-capital-climate-mobility.html">Human Capital, Mobility, and the Unequal Effects of Climate Change</a></h3>
<p class="paper-authors">Tim Dobermann</p>
<p>Examines how human capital creates mobility across sectors and locations as a channel for climate adaptation, combining a historical schooling expansion in India with a spatial model of structural change.</p>
</div>
<div class="paper-row-side">
<span class="paper-status">Working paper</span>
<a href="https://www.theigc.org/collections/structural-transformation-race-against-climate-change">IGC project page</a>
<a href="https://www.theigc.org/publications/human-capital-mobility-and-climate-change-adaptation">Policy brief</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="paper-row">
<div class="paper-row-main">
<p class="paper-meta">Energy markets · Pakistan</p>
<h3><a href="papers/economic-costs-lopsided-ppas-pakistan.html">The Economic Costs of Lopsided Contracts: Evidence from Power Purchase Agreements in Pakistan</a></h3>
<p class="paper-authors">With Faraz Hayat and Sugandha Srivastav</p>
<p>Builds a new database on power purchase agreements to study how asymmetric information and regulatory capture shape electricity prices and productive misallocation.</p>
</div>
<div class="paper-row-side">
<span class="paper-status">Working paper</span>
</div>
</div>

<div class="paper-row">
<div class="paper-row-main">
<p class="paper-meta">Field experiments · Energy · Pakistan</p>
<h3><a href="papers/pushing-on-a-string-pakistan.html">Pushing on a String? Price and Enforcement Interventions in Pakistan's Power Sector</a></h3>
<p class="paper-authors">With Robin Burgess, Michael Greenstone, Faraz Hayat, and Usman Naeem</p>
<p>Uses two randomised experiments with government to estimate how electricity payments and theft respond to price incentives and norm-based enforcement.</p>
</div>
<div class="paper-row-side">
<span class="paper-status">Working paper</span>
<a href="https://www.theigc.org/collections/pushing-string-price-and-enforcement-interventions-reduce-theft-pakistans-power-sector">IGC project page</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="paper-row">
<div class="paper-row-main">
<p class="paper-meta">Structural transformation · South Korea</p>
<h3><a href="papers/miracle-on-the-han.html">Deciphering the Miracle on the Han: How South Korea Escaped Poverty and Transformed its Economy</a></h3>
<p class="paper-authors">With Oriana Bandiera, Ignacio Bañares Sanchez, Robin Burgess, Jay Euijung Lee, Jeongkyung Won, and Hyunjoo Yang</p>
<p>Uses newly digitised historical microdata to study the roles of industrial policy, rural development, and infrastructure in South Korea's rapid transformation.</p>
</div>
<div class="paper-row-side">
<span class="paper-status">In progress</span>
<a href="https://www.theigc.org/collections/deciphering-miracle-han-how-south-korea-escaped-poverty-and-transformed-its-economy">IGC project page</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="paper-row">
<div class="paper-row-main">
<p class="paper-meta">Spatial economics · Energy · Ghana</p>
<h3><a href="papers/electricity-agglomeration-ghana.html">Electricity, Agglomeration, and Industrialisation in Ghana</a></h3>
<p class="paper-authors">With Ignacio Bañares Sanchez and Niclas Moneke</p>
<p>Estimates how the allocation of electricity outages affects firm productivity, entry, and industrial agglomeration across space.</p>

<h3><a href="papers/solar-diffusion-ethiopia.html">The diffusion of solar in rural economies</a></h3>
<p>Mapping how market structure, intermediaries, and spatial frictions shape off-grid solar coverage, prices, and adoption.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.theigc.org/collections/diffusion-solar-rural-economies-market-structure-intermediation-and-spatial-frictions">IGC project →</a></p>

<p class="paper-meta">Pakistan · Public finance</p>
<h3><a href="papers/customs-evasion-pakistan.html">Customs evasion and state capacity</a></h3>
